copy.titleEn: COBALT KNIT AT THE TRAM STOP

title.en: Cobalt knit at the tram stop

deck.ko: 트램을 기다리며 벤치에 앉아 풀린 부츠 끈을 다시 묶는 차림.
deck.en: Retying a loose bootlace on the bench while the tram is on its way.
deck.de: Auf der Bank an der Haltestelle den Stiefel neu schnüren, während die Tram kommt.

intro.ko: 트램 정류장 벤치에 걸터앉아 풀린 끈을 당깁니다. 차콜과 그래파이트 사이에서 코발트 집업 니트가 목과 손목에 선명한 파랑을 남깁니다.
intro.en: Perched on the tram-stop bench, he pulls a loose lace tight. Between charcoal and graphite, the cobalt zip knit leaves a sharp blue at neck and wrists.
intro.de: Auf der Bank der Tramhaltestelle zieht er einen losen Schnürsenkel fest. Zwischen Anthrazit und Graphit setzt der kobaltblaue Strick am Hals und an den Handgelenken ein klares Blau.

body.ko: 그래파이트 울 스카프까지 더해 목과 몸통을 따뜻하게 감쌉니다.
body.en: Finish the layers with graphite wool scarf.

tip.ko: 코발트는 목과 손목, 두 군데에서만 보이게 두면 어두운 아우터 속에서 더 또렷해요.
tip.en: Let the cobalt show in just two places — neck and wrists — and it pops against the dark outer.
tip.de: Das Kobaltblau nur an zwei Stellen zeigen – Hals und Handgelenke –, dann leuchtet es vor der dunklen Jacke.

ko.deck: 차콜 크롭 울 블루종에 코발트 리브 집업 니트을 겹친 초겨울 캐주얼.
ko.intro: 기온 6°C, 체감 3°C의 흐린 낮을 위한 차림입니다.
ko.tip: 니트 위에 입고 앞섶을 살짝 열어 레이어를 보여주세요.

en.deck: Charcoal cropped wool blouson over cobalt ribbed zip knit for an early-winter casual look.
en.intro: For an overcast day at 6°C that feels like 3°C.
en.tip: Wear it over knitwear and leave the front slightly open to show the layer.

de.deck: Kurzer anthrazitfarbener Wollblouson über Kobaltblauer Rippstrickpullover mit Reißverschluss für einen lässigen Start in den Winter.
de.intro: Für einen bedeckten Tag bei 6 °C, gefühlt 3 °C.
de.tip: Über Strick tragen und vorne leicht offen lassen, damit die Schicht sichtbar bleibt.

copy.rewriteReason: b222 Claude Code copy rewrite under design/IMAGE_MAPPING_HANDOFF.md 5-1: delivered intro and tip were one sentence for all 10 looks (tip = the outer's how-to-wear), product how-to-wear used 9 template sentences for 66 products, decks listed product names (ko particle error '니트을', de case errors). Titles, pulls, bodies and product names/descriptions are kept verbatim; rewritten fields keep the delivered text in source* fields. Written from the 10 approved editorials.

howToWear.en: Wear the short blouson open, ending above the waist, so the blue knit runs long.
